---
title: Marinara Mussel Soup
id: MAR-0122
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 2 kg mussels
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 1 garlic clove
- 5 tablespoons white wine
- 4 slices bread
## Method
1. Clean the mussels by scraping them and removing the beard.
2. Crush the garlic with the appropriate tool and mix it with the parsley.
3. In a saucepan, heat the oil and wilt the mixture over low heat for 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the mussels, raise the heat, pour in the wine, and when it has partially evaporated, cover and let the mussels open while shaking the pan up and down.
5. When they have opened (it will take about 5 minutes), turn off the heat.
6. Toast the bread in the oven at 220 °C for 5 minutes and place it in deep plates; distribute the mussel soup and serve.
